data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate recorded an underwriting profit before investment income of GBP 3.2m (2021: GBP 6.6m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result. (Page 3) The RITC impact for 2022 in Claims Provisions table was Gross 23,086. (Page 22) The 2020 Underwriting Year Accounts reported a Total loss for the underwriting year (9,588). (Page 31)

prior_year_events.impact_description: improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result
RITC impact of 23,086 (gross strengthening) on claims provisions, reflecting the loss for the 2020 underwriting year.
recovery of the 2019 Year of Account ("YOA") loss from capital providers during the distribution process.

named_events.loss_description: increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR.
Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ian.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 9.086m in 2022. This was primarily due to a GBP 23.086m gross strengthening related to the closure of the 2020 Year of Account, partially offset by a GBP 14.0m gross release from an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 Year of Account. Additionally, the Syndicate noted a recovery of the 2019 Year of Account loss. Claims incurred during the year were also impacted by the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years and Hurricane Ian.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is a net figure calculated from a GBP 14.0m gross release for 2021 YOA re-estimation and a GBP 23.086m gross strengthening for 2020 YOA closure (RITC impact). The gross claims development triangle was not used for PYD calculation due to inconsistencies with explicit narrative statements regarding specific YOA performance and RITC impacts.
